Item.Description: 'Type' determines the field to be shown in GUI.
Determines which tab this field belongs to. Value is treated as tab name, can be any characters.
The default value for this field. For the Number field, this default value can be <now.year> and will return the value of the current year.
Value that representing the distance, in pixels, between the left edge of the field control and the left edge of its container's client area.
Value representing the distance, in pixels, between the bottom edge of the field control and the top edge of its container's client area.
The width of the field control in pixels.
The height of the field control in pixels.
Value representing the data context used by this field.
